Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (11)
Something unseen was helping the Vamel Alliance.
Rondo let out a deep sigh as he recalled what Silyn had said. Now he was at the point of suspecting that, just as she had said, something transcendent was truly helping the Vamel Alliance.
If not for that, there was no way the tide of battle could be like this, despite the objective difference in military strength being so great. And that was not just Rondo's thought alone.
'What do they believe in, to fight so desperately?'
'They should be getting pushed back, but they're not... They're not falling. How in the world?'
The terror of an 'infinite' enemy rushing in.

Until now, it was the Vamel Alliance that had fought while suffering from that terror. And in reality, the Demon Army was sending out even more troops even after losing thousands of fleets and dozens of Genesis Knights.
However, now the soldiers of the Demon Army could not find any fear in the faces of the members of the coalition.

Even as their necks were pierced by staffs, even as their bodies were torn by rays of light, even as their entire bodies were mangled by magic, the members of the coalition did not stop their advance.
“Our stars are fighting at the front, hold on!”
“Brothers, we will not forget this day!”
From the sky and from the ground, the roars of the coalition members were echoing endlessly.
“Strike them down, those bastards are surely getting tired!”
“Sniper units, keep aiming at Jin Runcandel and the Genesis Knights, pour it on without a moment's rest!”
Before this fight began, the Demon Army had been certain that the result was already decided.
That they, who had conquered all dimensions, could not possibly be defeated by a single dimension. That no matter how fierce the resistance, in the end, nothing would change.

It was not a shallow fighting spirit based on mere obedience and blindness. It was the desperation to protect their world, the tenacity to choose their future with their own hands, and the bonds between them.

That fighting spirit had the power to make them withstand a fight they should have naturally been pushed back in. It had the power to make the impossible possible, just as the Genesis Knights had overcome fate, just like the power of existence that Jin possessed.
So to speak, it was infinite.
That was why it was now the Demon Army that was feeling fear. The fear of an infinitely rushing enemy, the terror that the result might just be overturned.
“You must think you're special. Conviction? Pride? That crap is nothing but an illusion!”
“I'll crush you all...!”
The Demon Army also screamed. A backlash against fear; no matter how advantageous the situation, they could not fight with a sane mind without denying the enemies' conviction.
The Genesis Knights of both sides were engaged in a fierce battle in the deepest part of the Demon Army' main force, and in front of them, the superhumans and the Holy Army were clashing.

At the center of the battlefield, the Vamel Alliance was maintaining its front line centered on the Runcandels and the Plutonians. Some of the Battle Kings who had been pushed back while performing the sealing of the Holy Army, and Mary, were leading the coalition members.
“Keoheok...!”
“Lord Daytona!”
“I'm fine, hold your position! We have to support Lady Mary! If we get pushed back, it becomes difficult for the fleet to support the Genesis Knights!”
“Kahaaaak!”
“As expected of Brother Jin's flesh and blood, the knights of Runcandel. They're quite brave!”
“Lord Linpa! To your left!”
Chwahaaaak-!

At Mary's voice, Linpa's greatsword spewed out a vivid blue lightning. It struck down all the magic rays that had flown in from the left, but the ground that those holding the center were standing on was suddenly splitting in half.
'The Black Sea should have been moving according to Father's will!?'
Even now, the Black Sea was in the middle of swallowing the white fleets and the troops of the Demon Army according to Chiron's will.

However, it was not as fierce as it was at the beginning. Chiron was clearly in a state of having consumed a great deal of mental energy while maintaining his ultimate technique for a long time, and right now, he, along with Jin, was receiving the most checks.
That was why he could not perfectly control the Black Sea. Furthermore, the enemies were also adapting to the battlefield as time passed.

Mary, the knights, and the Plutonians scattered and tried to escape the split ground. However, from between the sunken ground, thousands of green hands suddenly sprouted up and were seen grabbing the knights.
“Kraaa...!”

It was a dark-element linked magic that had never been manifested in this world. Not everyone could escape its grasp. About twenty guardian knights of Runcandel were captured and fell into the darkness, disappearing, and two common soldiers of the Plutonians were also taken.
“Brother Shul!”
“Scatter, evade!”

The magic knight order hastily tore paper and attempted to suppress the magic, but the Demon Army was a group of the most powerful mages from all dimensions. They easily checked the magic knight order and continued to expand the dark-element magic.
In an instant, the knights who were guarding the center of the battlefield were being massacred.

'It's not that something has happened to Father, it's that those bastards have caught us off guard! If the front line collapses like this, it will be difficult for the fleet's support to reach the Genesis Knights' battlefield...!'
Mary, who had created distance from the split gap, gritted her teeth, resolving to go back to the front and hold on.

“In the end, you all are nothing without a person like Jin Runcandel. You're not afraid of death? On the contrary, that is a blessing that only those like us who have transcended providence can enjoy!”
The moment the Tona twins, with the same thought, were preparing to throw their bodies in with her, there was someone who rushed into the dark-element magic before them.
The Twelfth Battle King, Teto; he had extended his spear and formed a lightning zone, blocking the sprouting green grasps.
Chiiiiik...!
“Keuuuk...!”
However, he could not block them all. The sight of five grasps that had broken through the lightning grabbing Teto's limbs and melting them followed.
“It's right that I, who am sturdy, hold on. Go quickly and take those bastards' necks! If I can't block this, all the guys here will melt!”

The three of them instantly passed Teto and rushed towards the mages hidden below the shield of the White Fleet. The swords of the Tona twins struck the shield first, and right after a crack was formed, Mary's Divine Serpent stabbed into it.

Puk-! The blade of the Divine Serpent pierced through the head of one mage and embedded itself in the ground. However, he was not the core of the linked magic, and the siblings attempted to infiltrate again to attack the other mages.
At that moment, a single ray of light from the sniper unit, which had been aiming only at the coalition's Genesis Knights the whole time, severed Heitona's right arm.
I've just lost one arm, Heitona thought. Behind me, a warrior who is clearly greater than myself is waiting for us to succeed, putting his entire body on the line.
“I will open the path! You and Daytona go in together!”
“How can you alone—!”
“I can do it!”

It was a shield that had only been slightly cracked even when he and Daytona had struck it with all their might just now. But perhaps because he was resolved, at the single blow that Heitona swung alone with his one remaining arm, the sight of one side of the White Fleet's shield being completely torn apart followed.
“Go!”

Finally, Mary and Daytona were able to completely enter the shield and cut down the cores of the linked magic. The heads of the dead mages rolled on the floor like balls and were crushed by the shockwaves of the battlefield, and the siblings looked back.

The green hands that had sprouted from the split floor had vanished in an instant. And Heitona was not standing in that place. Only the debris of his chain-sword, shattered to pieces while blocking the enemies' attacks that were flying towards Mary and Daytona's rear, remained.
Teto's voice could not be heard either. He had departed after shouldering all the poison of the dark-element magic on his own.
While Mary and Daytona were returning to the ranks, Beliz picked up the spear that Teto had used, kissed it once, and then plunged it into the ground.
“Crying comes later, Runcandels.”
“Yes, it comes later.”
“We will never be pushed back behind Brother Teto's spear, like now.”
“Of course, even if we die, it is in this place. No one passes!”
There had been a great sacrifice, but they had protected the central front. They focused only on that fact and pushed away the sorrow of having lost their brothers.

Thanks to that, the Golden Fleet could still solidly support the Genesis Knights. The swords of the Genesis Knights, who had just lost their children, their brothers, also did not waver in the slightest, like Teto's spear planted firmly in the earth.
However, in the fierce battlefield of the Genesis Knights, corpses were now beginning to pile up.

The fact that the enemies' corpses were not scattering like dust meant that Chiron was growing that much more tired. Having faced the enemy Genesis Knights for over two days, even if it was Chiron, he could not be the same as he was at the beginning.
However, the enemies still did not dare to face him and the Vamel Alliance's Genesis Knights head-on.
Not once had more than five of them established a position at the same time.
'Have they not been able to push through the central front until now? The only coalition Genesis Knight over there is Murakan, so what in the world are they doing...!'

For the command of the Demon Army facing the coalition Genesis Knights, it was a maddening situation. Even the Holy Army was being continuously sealed in the same manner as the Genesis Knights, so they could not expect any support from the troops that had already arrived on the battlefield.
'Lord Rondo will not send out the main force until the center is pushed through. Are the Genesis Knights this time also, in the end, just buying time...'
Rondo was scheduled to enter the battle after the Demon Army' Genesis Knights had secured the front line and he had confirmed that all of Lafrarosa's main cannon shots had been depleted.
However, the next moment.
From the dimensional gate closest to the Genesis Knights' battlefield, the 3rd flagship of the White Fleet, the Ridel, began to emerge.

At the same time, the 1st and 2nd flagships, which had just joined Rondo a little while ago, were also seen leaving the dimensional gate together. They had finished gathering the Genesis Knights from inside the dimensional gate and were prepared to send them all out onto the battlefield at once.
“Lord Rondo!?”
“Why is the main force coming now?”

The moment he saw that sight, Jin made a quick judgment. That he had to fire the Plutonian Cannon at this place now, even if he and his allied Genesis Knights would inevitably be swept up in a direct hit.
If not for that, an unbearable number of Genesis Knights were on board the white ships.
“Lafrarosa, ascend and fire the Plutonian Cannon here!”
Rondo watched Lafrarosa ascend, gave a bitter smile, and fixed his gaze on Jin.
“You'll be using the flying fortress's main cannon now, I see, Jin Runcandel. Let's die together. Let's see which side will survive to the end and ravage the remaining enemies?”
